verdict.rationale: Vercel's official MCP server exposes build logs (`get_deployment_build_logs` with an errorsOnly filter), deployment details (`list_deployments`/`get_deployment`), and runtime logs and grouped runtime errors (`get_runtime_logs`, `get_runtime_errors`, up to 7 days) through a single interface. The CLI is documented to retrieve logs, and the platform offers observability for traffic, function performance, and errors. Missing for 10: no first-party docs describing a unified dashboard log view that combines build, deploy, and runtime logs; no detail on CLI log coverage, retention, or filtering beyond the MCP tools; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
